set: B: tier 3 from above, the lobby doors and the table map beside the approved images, whole and in crops

issues.what: -b is a strictly flat top-down shot; -a is a near-vertical but clearly oblique shot in which the tower, the lift tube, the Retirement box and the flippers rise off the playfield with visible sides, so the two do not read as the same table photographed twice
issues.fix: tilt the camera back to -a's oblique angle so the tower stands up, the tube shows its side and the parts keep their height off the page

issues.where: the Corporate HQ sign band above the doors, and the same lettering in set-B-01-b.png and set-B-04-b.png
issues.what: the lettering is a flat black sans-serif print on a grey band; -a shows raised brushed-metal serif letters with weight, colour and sheen of metal catching the light
issues.fix: render the letters as metal serif forms with soft highlights, in the same weight, colour and place as -a

issues.where: the boardroom at upper left, also 'the long table' panel in set-B-02-b.png and the top tier of set-B-05-b.png
issues.what: -b draws a small orange plastic desk with green chairs and olive footrests, no lamps; -a shows a long dark walnut table with two rows of black chairs under warm brass lamps
issues.fix: give the piece a dark wood top with a warm sheen, black chairs, and the warm task lamps of -a

issues.where: the playfield below the boardroom, also the top tier of set-B-05-b.png
issues.what: the four yellow sticky notes scattered on the field in -a are missing in -b
issues.fix: place the four yellow notes where -a has them

issues.where: the tower body, also the tower in set-B-01-b.png, the 'the tower' panel in set-B-04-b.png, and the top tier of set-B-05-b.png
issues.what: the tower is a bare grey metal frame with exposed ceiling light strips and no glass; -a's tower is a glass curtain wall with warm lit office floors and reflections, so -b reads skeletal and unfinished
issues.fix: skin the tower in glass with warm interior glow and window reflections like -a

issues.where: the playfield light overall, and the backdrop of set-B-03-b.png, also set-B-05-b.png
issues.what: -b's field is dimmer and cooler, with large soft dark shadow pools across the upper half, and in the close view the surroundings beyond the table are bright flat grey slabs; -a's field is an even deep blue with warm localised lamp glows and a dark night backdrop
issues.fix: even out and lift the ambient light on the field, keep accent glows warm, and drop the surroundings back into darkness

issues.where: the hourglass floor insert below the ball, also 'a flipper' panel in set-B-02-b.png and the top tier of set-B-05-b.png
issues.what: the hourglass insert is dark grey and unlit while the magnifier and clipboard glow; in -a all three inserts are lit, the hourglass a bright silver-white like its neighbours
issues.fix: light the hourglass insert to match the brightness and colour of -a

issues.where: the carpet under the ball, also 'the arrow' panel in set-B-04-b.png
issues.what: -b puts a bright red glowing pool beneath and inside the ball; -a grounds the ball with a big soft dark cast shadow and one small warm highlight on the carpet
issues.fix: replace the red glow under the ball with a soft dark shadow cast away from the key light

issues.where: the right outer wall, the top wall and the tier-divider walls of set-B-05-b.png
issues.what: -b's outer strips are pale smooth grey with plain lozenge-shaped lamps; -a's are deep navy with gold trim and glowing chevron arrow lamps, and the walls otherwise carry no lit lamp rows
issues.fix: dark navy panels with gold edging and chevron arrow lamps, and drop the white pill lamp rows from the plain walls

issues.where: the revolving door on the carpet, also 'the post of the revolving door' panel in set-B-04-b.png
issues.what: the door's post stands at the left edge of the carpet with its blades sweeping off onto the bare floor; in the tier view and the intended look it stands on the carpet in front of the doors
issues.fix: centre the post on the carpet in front of the doors, as in the tier view

issues.where: 'the carpet' panel, also visible in set-B-03-b.png and the 'the revolving door' panel of set-B-02-b.png
issues.what: -b's carpet is a glossy ribbed cord with visible ridges and streaky shine; -a's is a soft matte plush crimson with a fine even pile
issues.fix: swap to a matte plush pile with the even crimson tone of -a and lose the ribbing and gloss

issues.where: 'the arrow' panel, also the cursor in set-B-03-b.png
issues.what: the cursor carries a heavy black outline and a mid-grey fill; -a's arrow is bright white with a fine dark edge and a glassier highlight
issues.fix: thin the dark edge and brighten the fill towards white

issues.what: the deckchair reads as a tilted flat brown slab and the palm as a flat green star, with washed-out sea; -a shows a readable striped lounger with legs and fronds with depth
issues.fix: give the lounger its striped body and legs, tone the palm, and keep the bright turquoise sea band of -a

issues.where: 'a slingshot' panel, also the slings in set-B-01-b.png
issues.what: the slings are flat dull grey with hard dark crack lines; -a's are bright white glossy marble with soft grey veining and warm rim light
issues.fix: whiten the marble, soften the veins and add the gloss highlights of -a
